linework.observation: Thick clean outlines define protagonist, tray, sink, galley counter and sealed door.

identity.observation: Bald protagonist and level-one navy coveralls remain consistent.

content.observation: Dishwashing action and submarine galley are clearly represented.

composition.observation: Wide full-body image with good headroom and narrow-aisle depth.

regions.lighting: Warm ceiling lamps and soft gray shadows.
